_note: SYNTHETIC demonstration zones for the TSMIRP prototype. Centres are well-known public places in Jaipur; the circles, radii and risk levels were chosen by hand to exercise the geofence and map features. They are NOT derived from crime data and say nothing about real safety at these places.
